jobs.title: A Book of Your Own
jobs.description: Editorâs Note: The following piece, by the late, great Herman Holtz, was to appear as part of Hermanâs âHindsights & Insightsâ column. It is part of our collection of âclassicsââarticles that stand the test of time no matter how many technologies come and go. Published with permission. It seems, from what I read every day on the TECHWR-L list, that it isnât at all easy for most people to break into a beginning tech writing job. Of course, that kind of Catch 22âyou need a job to get the experience you need to qualify for the jobâis far from unknown, especially in the high-tech working world. Itâs why prospective employers want to see clips and other evidence that you can write reasonably well, whether it is technical or not, before they will consider you. I was a tech writer long before I wrote my first book, although I had to jump through some difficult hoops to land my first tech writing job (a series of six tests on technology); however, a great deal of my work later, especially my consulting jobs, came about as a result of my books and the reputation they bestowed on me. Being published between covers brings you respect almost as quickly and surely as becoming known as a millionaire business owner does. Even now, it happens. A reader who owns a small business in Baltimore hired me recently to do some consulting with him, after reading one of my books published a few years ago. The gentleman had read several books on the subject of proposal writing and contracting, and he decided that my book reflected the kind of thinking he needed, although it was one of my most slender volumes. It is really not that difficult to turn out your first book if you select a subject that you are reasonably familiar with (and so can research efficiently) and plan ahead with a solid and well-thought-out outline. Remember that what you write does not have to be a thick tome. My books have generally run to about 275 to 500 pages, but I have also written my share of books that printed out to fewer than 200 pages. There Are Many Ways To Get Ideas For Books, And The More You Concentrate On The Need, The More New Ideas You Will Get. Here Are Just a Few Tips Start reading the periodicals that deal with the subject Probably they will be trade journals and may touch only lightly on the subject, but that is fine. But, how much is there to say about the subject? Is it useful detailâthat is, does a lightly-covered detail justify a book of its own? The book of mine I referred to here is a small book that presents sharply-focused abstracts on what I think to be the most important topics about proposal writingâa subject on which I have written more than one large, detailed book. The little book referred to here is virtually the opposite of expanding an article or two into a book. Browse libraries and book stores for current books on the subject Would you go about writing a book on the subject entirely differently? Would it be a better book? How? Why? Read books that devote a chapter to the subject. How about developing that chapter into a full book of its own? Think about what that information might mean to readers and to which readers Will it help someone start or improve their business? Improve their position in some way? Make it easier to learn a given subject? Think about the need for the information Is the subject a very popular one? Is it on how to be a better golfer, for example? Hard to lose with any good book on golf. The same for many other subjects. There is never an end to new books about the Civil War, even if you call it The War Between the States. But if you want your first book (I hope that it will be only your first) to help your business career, it is best to choose a serious business subject or other how-to book. Finally, remember that you donât have to write the book in a day. Do a few pages each day, and you will be surprised at how soon you have a book. jobs.title: This IS Your Dream Job
jobs.description: Here are two questions to ask yourself: 1) when are you most content? (Not âhappyâ per se, since happy moments are fleeting. 2) Does contentment ever happen for you during the workday? The average American worker spends 2080 hours per year on paid work. Over 30 years, that adds up to 62,400 hours. Thatâs a LOT of time to spend doing something you donât like doing. Research also shows that people will change careers at least 7 times during their lifetime. However, career changes arenât always drastic â you can change the focus of your daily work activity without changing jobs. Sometimes incremental shiftsâsmall changes in what you do and how you do itâare the best and most satisfying way to land that dream job The key is to concentrate on ways to shift paid job duties into activities that give you that feeling of contentment. Grab a Sheet Of Paper And a Pencilâor Open Up Your Favorite Word Processor And Work Through The Following Steps To Come Up With Your Own Action Plan To Realize Your Dream Job STEP 1: Think about your current job â make a list of the tasks that comprise your job. Highlight the ones you most enjoy performing in your job. Note the ones you canât stand STEP 2: Make a list of activities youâve done in the past that you are most proud of, and that you got the most satisfaction from. These can come from previous jobs, volunteer activities, school work, or hobbies. jobs.title: Ship to Shore Technician
jobs.description: Job Description As a Ship-to-Shore Technician, you will play a vital role in supporting the safe and efficient operation of vessels arriving and departing at the port. This position involves working on the dock to ensure the proper mooring, securing, and release of ships, while maintaining safety and operational standards. In addition to mooring responsibilities, the role will also involve performing general maintenance and support tasks as required to ensure overall port and equipment readiness. The Ship-to-Shore Technician is responsible for, but not limited to the following: Docking and Undocking Operations Assist in safely docking and undocking cruise ships at port using mooring lines, ropes, and related equipment. Work in coordination with the shipâs captain, crew, and port authorities to ensure that vessels are safely secured and aligned with docking infrastructure. Mooring Line Management: Handle and manage mooring lines, ensuring they are properly fastened, tense, and released. Perform visual inspection of mooring lines and related equipment regularly for wear and damage, ensuring everything is in safe working condition. (Regularly performed by ship crew) Ship and Dock Safety Maintain safety protocols during mooring procedures, ensuring that all tasks are performed in accordance with safety regulations. Monitor weather conditions and report any changes that could affect docking or undocking procedures. Communication and Coordination Communicate effectively with other team members on board and shore-based personnel. Work with the Port Authorities to ensure the timely and safe transfer of passengers and cargo. Emergency Procedures Be trained to respond in case of an emergency during docking or undocking operations, including accidents or hazardous situations. Ensure all mooring operations are conducted efficiently and safely, even under adverse weather conditions or emergencies. PPE Equipment (MANDATORY) Must always be in possession of steel toe boots (or prescribed non-slip safety shoes), safety vest, hard hat, gloves, radio/communication device. (To be provided by Carnival) Cleaning & Maintenance of Pier & Mooring Equipment & Fixtures: Ensure all mooring equipment such as winches, ropes, and fenders are properly maintained and operational (through visual checks and inspections). Gangway Inspections & Maintenance: Inspect gangway components for wear, corrosion, proper tension, secure connections, and smooth operation to ensure safe pedestrian access and functionality. Fenders: Conduct visual inspections of pier fenders and associated hardware to identify cracks, deformation, excessive wear, or damage caused by vessel contact, and report deficiencies as needed. Mooring Bollards: Regularly inspect mooring bollards for structural integrity, including corrosion, cracks, loose anchor bolts, foundation stress, and coating condition, to ensure safe vessel mooring. Stanchions & Pier Fixtures: Inspect stanchions and associated components for corrosion, damage, misalignment, or instability, ensuring they remain secure and serviceable. Ropes: Inspect ropes for wear, fraying, or damage, and verify they are properly positioned and suitable for continued use. Mooring Equipment Maintenance: Perform minor maintenance and repairs of mooring equipment when necessary. Pier & Dock Cleaning: Maintain clean, safe, and non-slip pier surfaces by removing dirt, salt, algae, stains, debris and other buildup by pressure washing and using prescribed cleaning equipment and solutions, along all designated cruise pier and trestle areas. Cleaning Equipment Operation: Safely inspect, operate, and maintain cleaning equipment, including scrubbers and pressure washers, ensuring proper use, cleaning, and storage after each operation. Additional Maintenance Support Activities Perform minor maintenance support to technical teams including plumbing, electrical, masonry, carpentry, and HVAC functions. jobs.description: Description At ScionHealth , we empower our caregivers to do what they do best. We value every voice by caring deeply for every patient and each other. Job Summary The Patient Access & Intake Coordinator plays a key role in facilitating a smooth and efficient patient admission process. This position provides vital administrative and operational support to the Business Development team and the Central Access and Authorizations Team (CAAT), ensuring timely initiation and management of referral activity. Responsible for launching the referral management process, the coordinator oversees admission workflows, gathers and verifies required documentation, coordinates information for necessary approvals, and communicates essential information to relevant departments. Acting as a central liaison between Business Development, facility leadership, and CAAT colleagues, this coordinates admission logistics, confirm readiness to receive the patient, and ensure all clinical and operational details are aligned prior to arrival. This role actively contributes to quality improvement, problem solving, and productivity initiatives within an interdisciplinary team model, demonstrating accountability and a commitment to operational excellence. Essential Functions Serves as key team member of the new Central Access and Authorizations Team (CAAT), focused exclusively on intake of referrals and building the initial case for patient admission. Responsible for initiating any patient referral by establishing patient account in appropriate referral management platform Performs a wide variety of typing assignments, including entering demographic information into referral platform and/or Meditech for admission Works with business development team to gather patient information, admission and facility details from multiple referral platforms and sources Validates data and enters complete details into referral platform, establishing the foundation for successful benefit verification, initial prior authorization and ultimate patient admission Manages the entry of care transition program referrals into appropriate platform and working with business development team to manage those referrals Supports the business development team in coordinating the admission of the patient by coordinating bed assignments and any necessary admission paperwork, in collaborating with designated owner at the facility. Confirms that insurance verification / auth is complete Validates patient account and profile and PIC days in appropriate systems of record Communicates specific patient needs for bed, equipment, supplies, pharmacy, and consult services based on information received from business development team Provides hospital team with needed information on pending/new admissions Coordinates bed availability with facility house supervisor Responsible for working with the business development team to maintain accuracy and integrity of the pending referral log in the referral platform, which may include: Review and reconciliation of referral log reports Review and reconciliation of patient accounts in referral management systems Participates in continuing education/ professional development activities Learns and develops full knowledge of the CAAT Admission Processes and actively seeks to continuously improve them. jobs.title: Chief of Staff the CEO
jobs.description: The job in one line You run the CEO's operating system: goals, cadence, and follow-through. You also personally own the projects that don't have a home yet. Everyday Dose is moving fast in a lot of directions at once. The constraint isn't ideas or effort. It's making sure the right handful of things get set, tracked, and actually finished while everything else keeps running. That's this job. It is not an executive assistant role and it is not a note-taking role. You'll own outcomes, run the meeting the leadership team is accountable to, and have a real seat. What You'll Actually Do Own goal setting. Run quarterly and annual planning end to end. Sit with each exec, turn intent into targets that are measurable and few. Hold the line when a goal is a paragraph instead of a number. Publish it so the whole company knows what we're playing for. Manage against those goals. Goals decay the week after they're written unless someone owns them. You're that someone. You track progress, surface slippage early, and escalate the things that need the CEO before they become fires. Run the weekly leadership meeting. Set the agenda, bring the numbers, drive to decisions. Every meeting ends with owners and dates, and you chase them down between meetings. You're not the scribe; you're the person who makes the hour worth everyone's time. Keep the scoreboard honest. Build and maintain the company-level reporting leadership runs on, in partnership with finance and data. Numbers come from the warehouse, not from someone's recollection on a call. If two sources disagree, you're the one who reconciles them. Run special projects. The high-stakes, cross-functional thing that has no owner: a new bet, a partnership, a channel or business we're deciding whether to enter, a problem that spans three teams and belongs to none of them. You get handed ambiguity and come back with an answer, a model, and a plan. Be the CEO's second read. Pressure-test decisions before they're made. Prep board and investor materials. Write the memo when the thinking needs to be sharp. Say the thing nobody else in the room will say. What Success Looks Like In 90 Days Company goals for the quarter are written, owned, and measurable, and every leader can recite theirs without opening a doc The weekly leadership meeting has a repeatable format, a live scoreboard, and decisions that stick One company-level dashboard everyone trusts, sourced from the warehouse Two special projects taken from ambiguous to finished without supervision The CEO's time visibly reallocated toward the highest-leverage work in the business Requirements What we're looking for 8 to 12 years of experience, including time as a Chief of Staff, BizOps lead, Strategy & Operations lead, or equivalent to a founder/CEO or a senior exec Top pedigree. Strong academic background and time at companies with a known high bar, plus a record of being promoted inside them. We look hard at both Left brain. You're fluent in a spreadsheet and comfortable in a data environment. You can build a model, size an opportunity, read a cohort curve, and pull your own numbers rather than filing a ticket and waiting Right brain. You write exceptionally well. Memos, board decks, exec comms. You can take a messy 90-minute discussion and turn it into one page that changes what people do You've run an operating cadence (OKRs or equivalent, weekly business reviews, planning cycles) at a company doing real volume, not as a theory from a deck Backbone. You will regularly tell senior, accomplished people that their goal isn't measurable or their project is late. You do it without drama and without flinching, and they respect you for it Startup metabolism. High ambiguity, fast context switching, nothing beneath you. You'd rather own the outcome than protect the org chart You use AI tooling daily to move faster on analysis, drafting, and research Bonus DTC, subscription, or CPG experience, especially a business with recurring revenue and real retenti

jobs.title: Tax & Corporate Structuring Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: As a Tax & Corporate Structuring Manager (m/f/d) , you will be responsible for designing and implementing tax-efficient corporate structures that support MIRAI Power's strategic growth across Europe. Acting as a trusted advisor on tax and corporate matters, you will play a key role in transactions, reorganizations, governance initiatives, and ensuring compliance with applicable tax regulations. Your Contribution to the Energy Transition Develop and implement tax-efficient corporate structures aligned with the company’s strategic, operational and commercial objectives. Advise on domestic and international tax matters, assessing the tax implications of investments, financing arrangements, new business initiatives and corporate transactions. Lead the tax aspects of mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, divestitures and internal reorganizations, while supporting legal entity governance and structuring initiatives. Ensure compliance with applicable tax legislation, transfer pricing requirements and reporting obligations, while proactively managing tax risks, audits and interactions with tax authorities. Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Treasury and external advisors, monitor regulatory developments and provide recommendations to senior management on tax planning and structuring matters. Your Profile 5+ years of professional experience in tax advisory, accounting, corporate tax, audit or the energy sector. Strong expertise in tax, corporate structuring, compliance and audit-related matters. Ability to interpret financial statements and provide recommendations to senior stakeholders. Strong leadership skills combined with a hands-on mindset and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Fluent in German and English. What We Offer at MIRAI Power Flexible Work Culture: We focus on results rather than rigid rules, offering a high level of trust, autonomy, and flexibility. Real Impact & Ownership: From day one, you will take on responsibility and have a direct influence on our projects, processes, and the future development of MIRAI Power. Collaborative Environment: We believe in short decision-making paths, open communication, and working together as equals - this is part of our everyday culture. Professional Development: Whether through technical training or business language courses, we actively support your personal and professional growth. Health & Mobility: We support your well-being with Wellpass as well as a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket or an individual mobility solution. Tulip brings modern technology and AI into manufacturing. Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology. In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work." jobs.description: Who We Are AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint. We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with current support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, and Python. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. We're investing deeply in making Develocity's unique data and decades of domain expertise accessible to both humans and AI agents, with trust, evidence, and explainability at the core of everything we build. We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community. Our Values Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding; we strive to understand diverse viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals.  Know the Why : We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration.  Innovate & Iterate : We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With a deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative, bold solutions to tackle challenges. Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative, and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results. Who You Are We're building a new SRE team and looking for founding members to help shape how we operate. As a Lead SRE, you'll be a technical and operational leader for reliability across Develocity. You'll help define our SRE vision, set standards for how we operate production services, and mentor other SREs as the team grows. This is a hands-on role with broad influence across engineering, cloud platform, and customer-facing teams. The SRE team will be responsible for the reliability, performance, and availability of Develocity instances serving paying customers, open-source projects, and public-facing services, plus supporting infrastructure like artifact registries. You'll work on our internally-built Cloud Application Platform, Kubernetes on AWS, and develop deep expertise in it. When incidents happen, you'll troubleshoot issues across the stack, from application to infrastructure. You'll collaborate with the Cloud Platform team to improve the tooling you depend on, and with engineering teams to build reliability into how we ship software. If you like automating things and hate doing the same task twice, you'll fit in well. You'll be part of a distributed, remote-first team that values asynchronous communication and written documentation. Strong self-direction and clear communication across time zones are essential. Responsibilities Operate and maintain all Develocity instances and supporting services in production. Define and evolve SRE standards, practices, and operating models, including on-call, incident response, postmortems, and SLOs. Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, acting as a technical escalation point for complex or high-severity incidents. Lead incident response and blameless r

If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><h3></h3> <p><strong>This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.&nbsp;</strong></p> <h3>Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring</h3> <p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>The Synthetic Monitoring squad builds and operates <a href="https://grafana.com/products/cloud/synthetic-monitoring/">Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring</a>, used by teams globally to proactively verify that their critical user journeys, APIs, and services work as expected - before their customers notice they don't.</p> <p>Synthetic Monitoring is a multi-tenant distributed system implemented in Go, running on Kubernetes across all major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), executing billions of synthetic tests each month from probe locations around the world and from customer-operated private probes.</p> <p>The product is in a scale phase, and our focus is on making Synthetic Monitoring a deeply integrated part of Grafana Cloud: connecting checks to real user experience and cross-product investigation workflows, making check results a trusted signal for AI-assisted workflows, and enabling large organizations to operate the product at enterprise scale on our infrastructure and on their own private probes.</p> <p>The role is full-stack in the real sense: the same engineer who designs how a check execution flows through scheduling, probes, and the telemetry pipeline should also be able to build the workflow that lets a user understand and act on the result.</p> <p>As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. jobs.description: Deine Aufgaben Retention entscheidet, ob aus dem ersten Kauf eine Beziehung über das ganze Hunde- und Katzenleben wird und genau dieses Spielfeld gehört Dir. Du bekommst Ownership über Lifecycle CRM bei 7 starken Petfood-Marken : Du verantwortest unsere Automations und Kampagnen von der Idee bis zum Go-Live - mit modernen Tools, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Impact. Du arbeitest selbstständig, triffst Entscheidungen und verbesserst schnell auf Basis von Ergebnissen. Du baust, betreust und optimierst Klaviyo-Flows und -Kampagnen für alle 7 Marken parallel (u.a. Wolfsblut, Herrmann's Manufaktur, pets Premium) - vom Welcome Flow bis zur Reaktivierung. Du verantwortest E-Mail als Kernkanal . Weitere Kanäle wie Print-Mailings, WhatsApp, SMS und RCS bauen wir perspektivisch aus - hier bringst Du kanalübergreifendes Denken ein. Du bringst Maßnahmen eigenständig live und iterierst auf Basis von Ergebnissen. Geschwindigkeit vor Perfektion : Du testest, misst und schärfst schnell nach. Du machst aus Daten konkrete Maßnahmen: RFM, Segmente, Produkt- und Engagement-Daten, Tierprofile, Predictions (Rebuy, CLV, Churn) werden bei Dir zu personalisierter, relevanter Ansprache. Storytelling ist Deine Stärke : Bei Produktion und Skalierung unterstützen Dich moderne Tools und Automatisierung - Du bringst die zündende Hookline, das initiale Design-Briefing und die emotionale Ansprache aufs leere Blatt. Du setzt AI- und Automatisierungstools selbstverständlich ein, um schneller von der Idee zum Live-Test zu kommen und mehr Zeit für Konzept und Creative zu gewinnen. Du kommunizierst Ergebnisse klar und auf den Punkt - intern wie mit unseren Marken-Stakeholdern und du arbeitest als Sparring-Partner auf Augenhöhe. Was Du mitbringst Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Hands-on-Erfahrung im CRM-/Lifecycle-Marketing mit messbaren Ergebnissen , idealerweise im E-Commerce/D2C. Sehr gute praktische Klaviyo-Kenntnisse (oder vergleichbare Marketing-Automation-Plattform). Du denkst in Customer Journeys und verstehst Retention-Mechaniken (Rebuy, CLV, Churn). AI-native Arbeiten ist für Dich selbstverständlich : Du setzt LLMs, n8n, Cursor und ähnliche Tools aktiv im Arbeitsalltag ein. Du baust selbst : Flows, Segmente und Templates entstehen in Deinen Händen. Du bringst sie eigenständig live, lernst aus Ergebnissen und iterierst schnell. Segmentierung, Trigger, A/B-Tests und Deliverability beherrschst Du sicher. Mit Consent und Datenschutz (DSGVO) gehst Du selbstverständlich sauber und verantwortungsvoll um. Du bist datengetrieben und übersetzt unsere Looker-Dashboards in konkrete Maßnahmen. Kreatives Gespür: Du setzt ein Briefing aus dem Nichts auf und bringst eine Kampagne mit einer starken Hookline auf den Punkt. Du verstehst den Zusammenhang zwischen Creative und Performance. Kategorie-Empathie für Copy und Creative : Du kannst Dich in die Perspektive von Tierhalter:innen hineinversetzen - und das zeigt sich in Deiner Ansprache. Was wir Dir bieten Verantwortungsvolle, spannende und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einem dynamischen Unternehmen , das flache Hierarchien und eine offene, lockere Arbeitsatmosphäre lebt, in der alle per "Du" sind Ein freundliches, offenes Team bestehend aus ca. 280 Mitarbeitenden in München, Leipzig und Albourne (UK) mit mehreren lieben Bürohunden an unseren Standorten Flexible Arbeitszeiten (die auf Vertrauensarbeitszeit basieren), Home-Office Optionen inkl. Verschiedene interne & externe Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten , die Du eigenständig nach Deinen Interessen auswählen kannst Deine mentale Gesundheit ist uns wichtig! jobs.description: About Zipline Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.  Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people's lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. About You and The Role Zipline is seeking a senior, strategic, and highly adaptable lawyer to lead and scale legal and compliance across multiple countries of operation in Africa. This role sits at the intersection of compliance execution and regulatory strategy and is critical to enabling Zipline's continued growth in complex and evolving regulatory environments. You will independently lead all Africa Legal & Compliance operations and strategy while serving as an integral member of Zipline International's high-impact Legal Team. You will also be a key member of the Zipline Africa Leadership Team, with the Heads of People and Finance and our Country Directors, and with a dotted reporting line to Zipline Africa's CEO. You will work cross-functionally with the Africa Leadership Team, Operations, Policy, Government Affairs, People, Finance, and Engineering, and will report directly to Zipline's Deputy General Counsel. This is a hands-on leadership role that offers the rare opportunity to build and shape the Legal function with significant autonomy, while benefiting from the collaboration and support of a larger global legal team. One day you may be advising on a complex Nigerian employment or a healthcare regulatory issue in Cote d'Ivoire; the next, developing compliance training for teams across Africa or helping the business navigate export controls, sanctions, anti-corruption, and other cross-border legal risks. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We are looking for a Data Engineer  to join our Data Products team . At Atolls, your role will be instrumental in helping us building a data platform and data products that helps many multiple teams at the company creating exceptional user experiences and empowering consumers to make informed and confident shopping decisions. As a key part of our team, you'll be directly involved in building and enhancing the digital destinations our users rely on throughout their shopping journeys. Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are. *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. Responsibilities: In this role, you will: Help build our next-generation data platform, using a modern technology stack that will enable new products and analytics capabilities across the company. Design, build, and own end-to-end data pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver high-quality data products used both for internal analytics and to power features experienced directly by our customers. Build, operate, and continuously improve the core data platform, including databases, clusters, streaming infrastructure, and other platform services, with a focus on reliability, scalability and performance. Continuously improve our engineering practices by enhancing CI/CD pipelines, automating workflows, adopting modern developer tooling, and leveraging LLMs to improve developer productivity.   Your Profile: We're looking for a Data Engineer with a strong software engineering mindset who enjoys building data platforms and is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation. Technical Skills: experience writing code in Python, strong SQL skills, and experience with cloud-based solutions on AWS or GCP. Nice to have technical Skills: ClickHouse, Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Kafka, MySQL, dbt, Airflow. Soft Skills: we are looking for a collaborative engineer who enjoys working closely with teammates, who proactively identifies opportunities for improvement and helps drive them to completion, with the ability to explain technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. jobs.title: Creator Manager TikTok Shop - DACH (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Wir suchen dich! TikTok Shop verändert gerade, wie Menschen online einkaufen – und du kannst von Anfang an mit dabei sein. GENUINE ist einer der führenden TikTok-Shop-Partner in Deutschland, und wir suchen einen Creator Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Standort in Köln. Du verwaltest keine Listen – du verantwortest die Creator-Strategie für einige unserer wichtigsten Marken. Deine Aufgabe: ein starkes Creator-Netzwerk aufbauen, Creators gezielt weiterentwickeln und TikTok-Trends in Formate übersetzen, die wirklich verkaufen. Werde Teil einer der gefragtesten TikTok-Shop-Agenturen Europas und übernimm Verantwortung für Creator Management und operative Umsetzung. Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben Marken-Verantwortung: Du betreust eine Auswahl unserer Kernmarken als dedizierter Ansprechpartner – von der Creator-Strategie bis zur Performance, immer mit dem Markenbild im Blick. Trend- & Formatentwicklung: Du erkennst aufkommende TikTok-Trends frühzeitig und entwickelst daraus neue Content-Formate, die konvertieren und skalieren. Creator Coaching: Du unterstützt unsere Affiliate-Partner aktiv – mit Hooks, Trend-Insights und Content-Feedback – damit ihre Videos nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern auch verkaufen. Creator Scouting & Aufbau: Du identifizierst vielversprechende Creator, holst sie an Bord und entwickelst langfristige Partnerschaften statt kurzfristiger Einzelaktionen. Creative Briefing: Du übersetzt Markenziele in klare, praxisnahe Briefings, die Creators befähigen, TikTok-nativen Content zu produzieren, der performt. TikTok-Zusammenarbeit: Du bist im regelmäßigen Austausch mit TikToks eigenen Teams, bleibst bei Algorithmus-Updates auf dem Laufenden und nutzt neue Features gezielt für deine Marken. Qualifikation Dein Profil Erste Erfahrungen im Influencer Marketing, Talent Management oder Social Media – idealerweise mit Fokus auf messbare Ergebnisse Du bist selbst auf TikTok zuhause, erkennst Trends bevor sie peaken, und weißt wie man daraus ein wiederholbares Format macht Du verstehst, wie TikTok-Hooks funktionieren, was Social Commerce ausmacht und wie man Creator-Content gezielt optimiert Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, gute Englischkenntnisse für die interne Abstimmung Du wohnst in Köln oder bist bereit, umzuziehen Benefits Was dich erwartet Direkte Wirkung: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege – deine Ideen landen nicht in endlosen Abstimmungsrunden, sondern werden umgesetzt. „Day-One“-Mentalität: Wir sind schnell. Dich erwartet ein internationales, energiegeladenes Team, in dem Ideen nicht in Meetings stecken bleiben, sondern umgesetzt werden. Echtes Wachstum: Du baust Expertise auf, die gerade zu den gefragtesten im digitalen Marketing gehört – Creator, E-Commerce, Live-Shopping. Starkes Team: International, schnell und mit einer offenen Atmosphäre – wir arbeiten hart und feiern das auch. Was wir suchen Wir suchen jemanden, der verstanden hat: Auf TikTok ist Content das Produkt. Wenn du den Spagat zwischen viralen Trends und messbaren Verkaufsergebnissen beherrschst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Über uns GENUINE ist einer der führenden TikTok-Shop-Partner in Deutschland mit Büros in Köln, Berlin, Shanghai und Hongkong. Unser Team bringt über neun Jahre Erfahrung aus dem Social-Commerce-Markt in China und Südostasien mit. Gegründet 2017 von Damian Maib in Shanghai, haben wir deutschen Marken geholfen, im chinesischen Markt Fuß zu fassen und Millionen von Konsumenten zu erreichen. Seit 2025 sind wir auch in Europa aktiv und unterstützen Unternehmen beim Aufbau ihrer TikTok Shops. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.   We're looking for a motivated and skilled  Senior Data Scientist   to join our  Team Greenrock  – Demand Division .   Our Tech team owns Flix's  Revenue Management System  (RMS), a production system with a direct commercial impact. We are looking for a colleague who will play an active role in shaping the next generation of the RMS by leveraging their deep expertise in revenue management.   This is a hands-on senior role in a non-greenfield environment: delivering meaningful change requires care, conviction, and patience.   About the Role Work closely with commercial stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped projects and respond to operational inquiries. Translate revenue management theory and industry best practices into concrete, testable improvements, from idea and experimentation through to production rollout. Co-own the evolution of the entire system through regular collaboration and discussions with peers across your team and neighboring engineering teams. Contribute to the technical health, reliability, and observability of the existing system.   About You Education and Revenue Management  expertise (must-have) Advanced degree ( Master's or PhD ) in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics , or a related quantitative field Solid theoretical foundation in RM: demand modeling, dynamic pricing, and network revenue management. Applied experience with RM or pricing tech solutions in transportation, travel, hospitality, retail, or a comparable domain is a big plus.   Engineering and data craft   Strong hands-on Python (including NumPy, Polars, Pandas, SciPy) and comfort with SQL on large datasets. Production-code experience is welcome but not required; what we expect is genuine interest in writing, reviewing, and maintaining code that runs reliably in production.   Soft skills   Excellent communication: you explain complex quantitative concepts or optimisation trade-offs to technical and non-technical, commercial audiences alike, and you enjoy educating and advocating for sound RM solutions. Senior judgment: you scope your own work, balance short-term fixes with long-term direction, and respect the constraints of an existing system.   We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Java/SpringBoot)
jobs.description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.  We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Java/SpringBoot) to join our Shopping team in Berlin . At Atolls, your role will be instrumental in helping us to let our consumers maximize value for their money by providing a world-class shopping rewards experience online and in-store, creating exceptional user experiences and empowering consumers to make informed and confident shopping decisions. As a key part of our team, you'll be directly involved in building and enhancing the digital destinations our users rely on throughout their shopping journeys. Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are. *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. Responsibilities: In this role, you will: Design and develop modern architectures using Java, AWS technologies, microservices, NoSQL & RDBMS, event-driven architectures, etc. Be involved in the inception, development, and delivery of various features and products on an ambitious and challenging product roadmap. Take responsibility for our solution architecture and contribute to improving it in terms of performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency. Be involved in multiple projects at the same time and manage your time effectively. Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions through presentations and hands-on tasks that help practice new technologies.   Your Profile: We're looking for someone with 6+ years of experience, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation. 6+ years of experience in designing and developing complex modular applications from technical planning to implementation within a client-side framework as well as server-side. Strong knowledge and active hands-on experience of Java and SpringBoot . Object-oriented programming concepts with application to concurrent event-based systems. Previous knowledge and experience with JS (TypeScript, NodeJS), HTML, CSS and React/Angular. Knowledge of AWS technologies such as DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, relational and NoSQL databases, EventBridge and messaging and queuing solutions like SQS, SNS (or any other cloud platform like Google Cloud or Azure). Experience with GraphQL, federation and Supergraph concepts. Excellent understanding of common design/architectural patterns, and the ability to produce elegant designs in modular/microservice design patterns. Logical, analytic thinking, structured and target-oriented approach, very good problem-solving skills. Passion for delivering clean code

jobs.title: Finance & Operations Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About GENUINE GENUINE is at the forefront of the social commerce revolution. As a fast-growing TikTok Shop Agency, we don’t just create content—we build high-converting shopping experiences. We operate at the intersection of entertainment and commerce, moving at the speed of a viral trend. To fuel our next stage of growth, we are looking for a data-driven Finance & Operations Manager who thrives in a high-speed environment. The Mission You will be the architect of our financial engine. Your goal is to ensure that as our GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) is strongly growing, our margins remain healthy and our cash flow stays liquid. You will bridge the gap between TikTok’s backend data, our payouts, and our internal profitability. Aufgaben Your Key Responsibilities Revenue & Commission Reconciliation: Manage the complex flow of funds from TikTok Shop, including platform fees, affiliate payouts, and client disbursements. Performance Controlling: Analyze the ROI of creator campaigns and live-stream sessions. You tell us which creators are profitable and which aren't. Cash Flow & Payout Management: Ensure creators and partners are paid accurately and on time while optimizing our own working capital. Process Automation: You will help implement and oversee tools that connect TikTok Shop data with our accounting software Commercial Strategy: Support the leadership team in pricing our services—moving from pure retainers to performance-based models (revenue share). Qualifikation Your Profile Experience: 2-4 years in Finance, Controlling, or Ops. Experience in E-commerce, D2C brands, or Affiliate Marketing is a massive plus. Data Literacy: You are a Google Sheets/Excel wizard. You don't just see numbers; you see patterns and "leaks" in the funnel. Agility: You thrive in "organized chaos." A TikTok algorithm change doesn't scare you; you adapt the reporting by EOD. Tech Savvy: Familiarity with e-commerce backends (Shopify, TikTok Shop Seller Center) and modern fintech tools (Spendesk, Moss, etc.). Benefits What’s In It For You Front-Row Seats to the Future: Join the #1 TikTok Shop partner in Germany. You won’t just be watching social commerce grow; you’ll be the one building it across Europe for the world’s most iconic brands. A "Day One" Culture: We move fast. Enjoy an international, high-vibe team environment where your ideas don't get stuck in meetings—they get executed. Direct Impact, Zero Red Tape: Work in a flat hierarchy where you collaborate directly with seasoned experts and have the autonomy to own your projects. The Cologne Lifestyle: Our modern HQ is located right in the heart of Cologne, surrounded by the city's best energy (and coffee). Serious Growth: Whether it’s client management, creative production, or deep-dive e-commerce, you’ll be gaining a toolkit that is currently the most in-demand in the global marketing industry. Team Spirit: We work hard, but we celebrate even harder with regular team events and an appreciative, open atmosphere. We are the largest TikTok Shop partner in Europe, and we are looking for someone to help us bridge the gap between creative production and modern e-commerce. If you’re ready to lead the social commerce revolution in Europe, we’re ready for you. About Us: GENUINE is one of Germany's leading TikTok Shop partners with offices in Shanghai, Cologne, Hong Kong, and Berlin. Our team brings more than nine years of experience from the social commerce market in China and Southeast Asia. GENUINE was founded in 2017 by Damian Maib in Shanghai. There, we helped German brands gain a successful foothold in China and position their products in front of millions of consumers. Since 2025, we have also been active in Europe, assisting leading companies in setting up their TikTok Shops. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: Growth Marketer heißt bei uns nicht „ein bisschen von allem". Es heißt: Du treibst unser Wachstum – mit Meta Ads als Fundament. Influencer und weitere Wachstumskanäle stehen bei uns nicht auf einer Wunschliste, sondern auf der Roadmap – und du baust sie mit auf. Was wir nicht suchen: den Bauchladen, der fünf Plattformen halb bespielt und überall Mittelmaß liefert. Wir suchen jemanden, der Meta auf Weltklasse-Niveau beherrscht und von dieser Basis aus den nächsten Kanal ernsthaft aufbaut – statt von einem zum nächsten zu springen. Zweiter Punkt, bevor du weiterliest: Wir arbeiten AI-nativ. Das schreibt inzwischen jeder, deshalb konkret: Wir bauen eigene AI-Werkzeuge. MCP-Anbindung an unsere Ad-Accounts, automatisierte Audits, Anomalie-Erkennung, eigene Skills für Angle- und Skript-Entwicklung. AI ist bei uns Standard-Werkzeug, nicht Notnagel. Wer 2026 noch jede Analyse von Hand baut, ist uns zu langsam. Wer umgekehrt jede Entscheidung an die AI abgibt, liefert denselben Output wie jeder Wettbewerber mit demselben Modell. Wir suchen die Mitte: Du steuerst, AI beschleunigt. Wenn dich beides anzieht – Tiefe statt Bauchladen, AI als Hebel statt als Ersatz fürs Denken – lies weiter. Wer wir sind SKINBRO ist eine schnell wachsende Männerpflege-Marke aus Hamburg: feste Seifen, feste Shampoos, Deos und Parfums – natürlich, plastikfrei, Made in Germany. Wir verkaufen über Shopify, Amazon und TikTok Shop und wachsen im DACH-Raum weiter. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen. Wenn du feststellst, dass nicht die Ads das Problem sind, sondern das Offer, das Bundle, der Preis oder die Landingpage: Das wird bei uns entschieden, nicht anderswo. Du musst niemanden überzeugen, der weit weg sitzt – du bringst es in den nächsten Call ein, und wenn deine Analyse überzeugt, wird es geändert. Was das für die Rolle heißt: Bei uns sinkt manchmal der ROAS im Werbeanzeigenmanager, während das Geschäft wächst. Und das ist dann genau richtig. Wer in Tages-ROAS denkt, wird bei uns unglücklich. Du baust unsere weiteren Wachstumskanäle mit aus, Influencer voran: Welcher Kanal verdient das nächste Budget, was lässt sich aus den Meta-Learnings übertragen, wo endet ein Test und wo beginnt ein Kanal? jobs.title: IT-System Engineer für Endpoint Management & MDM
jobs.description: Die thinkRED versteht sich als IT-Partner für Behörden, Kommunen und Bildungseinrichtungen in Deutschland. In großen Hardware- und Dienstleistungs-rahmenverträgen begleiten unsere Experten Kunden der öffentlichen Hand mit ausführlicher und individueller Beratung von der Konzeption der Infrastruktur bis hin zur operativen Umsetzung. Innerhalb unserer Abteilung Professional Services bildet das Team Endpoint/MDM eine tragende Säule bei der Digitalisierung moderner Arbeits- und Lernumgebungen. Arbeiten bei der thinkRED: Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und präge Visionen! Wir gestalten Digitalisierung ganzheitlich, zukunftsfähig und verlässlich. Aufgaben Ihre Aufgaben: Vom technischen Rollout bis zum Architektur-Design Du bist ein umsetzungsstarker „Macher“ bei der technischen Installation und kannst Dir vorstellen in die Rolle eines strategischen Consultant , der für unsere Kunden maßgeschneiderte Endpoint-Architekturen designt, hineinzuwachsen. MDM-Integration: Installation, Konfiguration und Administration von Mobile-Device-Management-Systemen in komplexen Kundenumgebungen. Device Lifecycle: Einbindung und Verwaltung unterschiedlicher Endgeräte-Plattformen (iOS/iPadOS, macOS, Windows, Android). Consulting & Design: (Je nach Eignung) Aufnahme von Kundenanforderungen, Durchführung von Readiness-Checks sowie das Konzeptionieren und Designen zukunftsfähiger IT-Infrastrukturen. Plattform-Verknüpfung: Integration von Schulserver-Lösungen und Schul-Plattformen in die bestehende MDM-Landschaft. Support & Weiterentwicklung: Begleitung der Rollout-Phasen, Erstellung von Dokumentationen und fachliche Betreuung unserer Endkunden. Qualifikation Ihr Profil: Endpoint-Spezialist mit Leidenschaft für Vielfalt Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich des modernen Workplace-Managements mit und hast Interesse daran, digitale Infrastrukturen (insbesondere im Bildungs- und Behördensektor) aktiv mitzugestalten. Technische Voraussetzungen: Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene IT-orientierte Ausbildung (z. B. Fachinformatiker Systemintegration) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung. MDM-Expertise: Gute Kenntnisse in JAMF (School, Pro) , idealerweise kombiniert mit praktischer Erfahrung in Relution und/oder Microsoft Intune . Schulumgebungen (Ein Plus): Erste Erfahrungen im Umgang mit IServ oder vergleichbaren Schulnetzwerk-Lösungen sind von großem Vorteil. Betriebssysteme: Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen Client-Betriebssystemen (Windows, iOS, macOS, Android). Soft Skills & Persönlichkeit: Flexibilität: Sie haben Spaß daran, sich auf unterschiedliche Kundenstrukturen und technologische Ökosysteme einzustellen. Kommunikationsstärke: Als Consultant können Sie technische Konzepte verständlich vermitteln; als Techniker packen Sie tatkräftig und lösungsorientiert an. Selbstständigkeit: Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch an Ihre eigenen Ergebnisse. Benefits Benefits: Firmenwagen, Homeoffice, Bike-Leasing-Angebote für Dich und Deine Familie, Trainingsmöglichkeiten in kooperierenden Fitnessstudios, kostenloses Mittagessen am Healthy Wednesday an den Standorten Mainz und Bad Soden. Bereit für das nächste Level im Endpoint Management? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen unter Angabe Ihres frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung an: thinkRED GmbH z.H. Benefits What do we offer? Immediate start date A fixed-term contract for 6 months , with potential to extend. An international, collaborative and dynamic work environment QH University that offers continuous training tools for all seniority levels. Our chemists, engineers and industry experts partner with our customers to continually improve their operations so they can run even more efficiently, even more effectively, whatever comes next. jobs.title: Senior Data Modeler (Data Vault)
jobs.description: Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale. We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain. We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core. Role As a Senior Data Modeler, you will play a key role in designing and delivering robust, scalable data models that enable our clients to unlock the full value of their data. You will contribute to critical data initiatives by creating reusable, business-aligned data assets that address complex business challenges. Your work will directly support enterprise data strategies and the implementation of modern, automated data solutions. You will work closely with client teams to ensure data model consistency, quality, and alignment with enterprise architecture and strategic priorities. By joining Visium, you will work alongside experts in modern data platforms, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI specialists. Our focus is on enabling customers to make their AI use cases enterprise-ready. Since the quality and preparation of data are crucial for AI success, your role will ultimately empower customers to be ready for an AI-driven future. As an Expert Data Modeler, this is part of your day-to-day activities: Translate complex business needs into robust models (focus Data Vault 2.0), including conceptual, logical, and physical layers. Design and implement scalable, auditable data products using Data Vault patterns. Ensure modeling consistency and alignment with enterprise standards, especially across multiple data domains and delivery teams. Collaborate with client stakeholders and data teams to clarify requirements, define model scope, and align on delivery timelines. Integrate models with modern data platforms with state-of-the-art toolchains (CI/CD, Git) Act as a subject matter expert on modeling approaches, mentoring peers and guiding teams on advanced Data Vault use cases. Requirements To apply, this should be part of your background: 4+ years of experience in data modeling, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale data solutions. Experience in data modelling techniques (Dimensional, Data Vault) Understanding of conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling and their application in modern data ecosystems. Solid grasp of data governance principles, metadata management, and maintaining business term alignment across models. Experience working in agile environments with a DevOps toolchain (CI/CD, Git, Automation tools) Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional client teams. Fluency in SQL and experience integrating models into data pipelines and BI/reporting layers. Ability to mentor peers and guide modeling decisions, serving as a trusted expert within project teams. Fluent in English. This role involves frequent travelling to Barcelona or any other client site. Plus: Data Vault 2.0 certification Experience with dbt and Databricks CI/CD practices and pull request workflows for data models. We know that great candidates might not check every box. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Identity & Agent Protocols (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Trusted Shops creates digital trust between people, businesses, and AI Agents. Every day, millions of consumers rely on our solutions to make confident online decisions, while businesses use our products to build trust, strengthen customer relationships, and grow sustainably.  With around 700 colleagues across Europe, more than 25,000 online shops, and over 40 million consumers in our Community of Trust, we are helping shape a safer and more transparent digital world. But trust is not only at the heart of our products – it also shapes how we work together. We believe in collaboration, ownership, and the freedom to do your best work through a flexible hybrid work culture.  Join us and help create a digital world where trust, transparency, and meaningful connections drive every interaction.    To strengthen our Engineering Team, we are looking for a  Senior Software Engineer - Identity & Agent Protocols (f/m/d) Cologne (hybrid) or Berlin (remote) | Permanent Contract (Full-time)  We're building the trust layer for agentic & human commerce: a Trust Authority that issues and verifies credentials for AI agents acting on behalf of consumers and shops. The protocol, the APIs and the UI - you would be a core engineer on it. Your Key Responsibilities as a Senior Software Engineer (f/m/d): Design and build the APIs and services behind our Trust Authority - credential issuance, verification, refresh and revocation. Develop cross‑platform Web Components Work with open identity standards such as OAuth2 / OIDC, passkeys, Verifiable Credentials, did:web, Web Bot Auth Own the system design - service boundaries, data models, API contracts - and make the calls that others build on. Build and run it on AWS with Terraform (Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, KMS), including monitoring and alerting. Ingest and analyse agent traffic, and turn raw signals into something we can act on. Own our automated testing: build the end-to-end, contract and visual regression suites in CI (Playwright) from scratch, so we release without manual regression checking. Take features from unclear idea to production and keep them healthy. Strong backend engineering, ideally in Node.js / TypeScript. Depth matters more to us than the specific language - part of our stack is Java (Keycloak). Frontend experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS. Real API and system design experience: you've designed APIs other teams depend on, and you can explain your trade-offs. Hands-on AWS and infrastructure as code (Terraform). You deploy your own changes. Solid security fundamentals: OAuth2 / OIDC, secure API design, and the basics of signing and key management. You've built automated test suites others rely on, not just tests alongside your own features. Hands-on with a modern E2E framework such as Playwright or Cypress. You're comfortable when the answer isn't known yet, and you decide with incomplete information. Nice-to-haves: Verifiable Credentials, DIDs, WebAuthn / passkeys, or HTTP message signatures. jobs.title: CAM Engineer / CAM-Programmierer(m/w/d)
jobs.description: PolyTALENT unterstützt ein stark wachsenden Partner in Hamburg bei der Besetzung dieser verantwortungsvollen Position als CAM Engineer (m/w/d) Unternehmen Unser Partner treibt mit fortschrittlichen Werkzeugmaschinen, Robotik und eigenentwickelter Software die industrielle Beschleunigung kritischer Industrien voran — Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung, Energie. Als Teil eines internationalen Fabriknetzwerks entsteht jetzt der erste deutsche Standort in Hamburg. Benefits Technische Verantwortung über Programmierstandards für das gesamte deutsche Netzwerk Arbeit an sicherheitskritischen Bauteilen für Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Verteidigung Zugang zu modernen 5-Achs-Werkzeugmaschinen und wachsender Automatisierung Equity-Beteiligung an einem skalierenden Fabriknetzwerk Gründungsteam-Rolle — du baust eine Fabrik von Null auf Einfluss auf Werkzeugbibliotheken und Best Practices, die über alle Standorte repliziert werden Leistungskultur mit Fokus auf kontinuierliche Verbesserung Aufgaben CNC-Toolpaths programmieren, simulieren und optimieren (3-Achs- und 5-Achs-Fräsen) Jobs nach Luft- und Raumfahrt- sowie Verteidigungsstandards einrichten, einfahren und produzieren Zykluszeiten reduzieren und Maschinenauslastung von Tag eins verbessern Werkzeuge, Schnittparameter und Spannstrategien für anspruchsvolle Materialien auswählen (z. B. Aluminium, Stähle, Titan, Inconel) Vorrichtungsstrategien entwickeln und verbessern Komplexe technische Zeichnungen und GD&T lesen und interpretieren Toolpath-Bibliotheken, Programmiervorlagen und Dokumentation von Grund auf aufbauen Neuteileeinführungen (NPI) von der Zeichnung bis zur stabilen Produktion unterstützen DFM-Rückmeldungen an Kunden beisteuern Eng mit dem Softwareteam zusammenarbeiten, um Datenerfassung, Planung und Automatisierung zu verbessern Maschinisten auf Programmierstandards schulen, wenn das Team wächst Fabrik mit aufbauen — Maschinen installieren, Anlagen in Betrieb nehmen, Abläufe definieren . Profil Fundierte CAM-Programmiererfahrung (z. B. Hypermill, Mastercam, Siemens NX oder vergleichbar) Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, enge Toleranzen zu fertigen (±0,01 mm und darunter) Erfahrung im Einrichten und Fahren von High-End-CNC-Maschinen (z. B. Hermle, DMG Mori oder vergleichbar) Tiefes Verständnis von Vorschüben, Schnittgeschwindigkeiten, Werkzeugstrategien und Spanntechnik Hands-on — du kannst sowohl programmieren als auch die Maschine selbst fahren Saubere Dokumentation und Revisionsdisziplin Souverän in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und ohne vorgegebene Strukturen Wünschenswert Hintergrund in der Luft- und Raumfahrt- oder Verteidigungsfertigung Erfahrung in der simultanen 5-Achs-Bearbeitung Erfahrung mit Titan, Inconel und hochfesten Legierungen NC-Simulationswerkzeuge (z. B. Vericut) Erfahrung mit Messtastern, Automatisierung oder Palettensystemen Kenntnisse in EN 9100 / AS9100 Ansprechpartner Bei Interesse oder Rückfragen wenden Sie sich bitte an: PolyTALENT GmbH Alessandro Quintiero +49 15888 6309 54 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Schülerpraktikant (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Saison für Saison entwickeln wir als familiengeführte Unternehmensgruppe erfolgreiche Kollektionen, die inzwischen in über 70 Ländern und 15.000 Schuhgeschäften zu finden sind. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Dass dieses Konzept aufgeht, spiegelt unsere Erfolgsgeschichte wider.  Du möchtest im Rahmen Deines Schulpraktikums oder freiwilligen Praktikums unsere Unternehmenswelt kennenlernen? Dann bewirb Dich bei uns als Schülerpraktikant (m/w/d) . Praktikumsverlauf: Du durchläufst verschiedene kaufmännische Abteilungen und lernst die Abläufe und Prozesse in den einzelnen Bereichen kennen. Du erarbeitest eigenständig kleinere Projekte und Aufgaben. Du begleitest unsere Auszubildenden und dual Studierenden bei ihrer täglichen Arbeit. In den grün markierten Monaten hast Du noch die Chance, einen unserer begehrten Praktikumsplätze zu ergattern: Was Dich ausmacht: Du solltest mindestens 14 Jahre alt sein und die 9. Klasse besuchen. Du bist dabei, einen der folgenden Abschlüsse zu machen: Abitur, Fachgebundene Hochschulreife oder Fachhochschulreife. Du hast Spaß an Mode, bist kommunikativ, wissbegierig und ein echter Teamplayer. Trifft unsere Beschreibung genau auf Dich zu? Dann stell' Dich mit Deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen bei uns vor: Motivationsschreiben: Warum Du? Warum wir? Tabellarischer Lebenslauf Die letzten 2 Schulzeugnisse Sonstige Qualifikationsnachweise Wir freuen uns auf Dich! jobs.description: <p><strong>Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.</strong></p> <p><strong>GET TO KNOW US</strong></p> <p>At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.</p> <p>We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!</strong></p> <p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p> <p>We are hiring an<strong> Employee Relations Senior Specialist – Works Council </strong>to our <strong>People </strong>team in<strong> Berlin, Germany!</strong></p> <p>This role is to join our dedicated Employee Relations (ER) team, reporting directly to the Director of Employee Relations. As our primary point of contact for German Works Councils, you will act as a strategic bridge between the business and employee representatives. You will work closely with Legal, HRBPs, and leadership to navigate co-determination law, finding pragmatic solutions that support our growth while maintaining constructive relationships. This is a vital position for someone who knows the BetrVG inside out and wants to drive impact in a high-growth, mission-driven environment.</p> <p><strong>YOUR IMPACT</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Manage day-to-day relationships</strong> with German Works Councils, ensuring communication remains clear, structured, and proactive.</li> <li><strong>Draft, review, and negotiate</strong> works agreements (Betriebsvereinbarungen) in close coordination with Legal and key stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advise HRBPs and business leaders</strong> on co-determination rights, BetrVG requirements, and complex employee relations matters.</li> <li><strong>Support critical business projects, </strong>including organizational changes, policy rollouts, and tech implementations, ensuring Works Council consultations represent business needs.</li> <li><strong>Maintain thorough documentation</strong> of all Works Council interactions, agreements, and negotiation outcomes to ensure compliance and continuity.</li> <li><strong>Contribute to broader European employee relations</strong> topics, providing expertise to support other markets as needed.</li> <li><strong>Live the mission:</strong> inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHO YOU ARE</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>A seasoned Labor Relations expert</strong> with at least 5–8 years of experience specifically focused on German co-determination and employee relations.</li> <li><strong>A subject matter expert</strong> with solid knowledge of German labor law, particularly the BetrVG (Works Constitution Act).</li> <li><strong>A skilled negotiator</strong> with hands-on experience drafting works agreements and representing comp

From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. You’ll work closely with product and engineering teams to identify opportunities for improvement, develop innovative solutions, and drive revenue growth for the hotels that rely on our platform. jobs.title: Senior AI Research Scientist (Model-based RL)
jobs.description: About Phaidra Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation. The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades. Phaidra creates AI-powered control systems for the industrial sector, enabling industrial facilities to automatically learn and improve over time. Specifically: We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions. We focus on industrial applications, which tend to be well-sensorized with measurable KPIs — perfect for reinforcement learning. We enable domain experts (our users) to configure the AI control systems (i.e. agents) without writing code. They define what they want their AI agents to do, and we do it for them. Our team has a track record of applying AI to some of the toughest problems. From achieving superhuman performance with DeepMind's AlphaGo , to reducing the energy required to cool Google's Data Centers by 40%, we deeply understand AI and how to apply it in production for massive impact. Phaidra’s ability to achieve its mission is determined by our ability to work together — as defined by our core values: Transparency , Collaboration , Operational Excellence , Ownership , and Empathy. We seek individuals who embody these values, as they are instrumental in ensuring our team consistently delivers excellence and fosters an engaging and supportive culture Phaidra is based in the USA, but we are 100% remote with no physical office. We hire employees internationally with the help of our partner, OysterHR . Our team is currently located throughout the USA, Canada, UK, Sweden, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Singapore, Australia, and India. Who You Are Research Scientists at Phaidra lead our efforts in developing novel algorithmic architecture towards the end goal of bringing intelligent control systems to industrial sector. Having pioneered research in the world's leading academic and industrial labs as PhDs, post-docs or professors, Research Scientists join Phaidra to work collaboratively within and across research fields. Drawing on expertise from a variety of disciplines including model-based reinforcement learning, planning and optimal control, deep learning, world models, and safe reinforcement learning, our Research Scientists are at the forefront of groundbreaking research and applying it to real-world industrial control systems. Responsibilities Design, implement, and evaluate model-based reinforcement learning agents — including planning-based controllers (MPC, MPPI) — and the software prototypes needed to deploy them on real industrial control systems. Develop learned dynamics and world models (learned surrogates) that generalize across systems, including the training pipelines — pretraining, curriculum learning, active/adversarial learning, and fine-tuning — needed to make them reliable for planning and control. Research and implement methods for e.g. safe RL, constrained control, scenario planning and Bayesian RL, to develop agents that satisfy safety constraints during deployment. Report and present research findings and developments including status and results clearly and efficiently both internally and externally, verbally and in writing. Participate in and organize ambitious collaborative research projects, and work with external collaborators and partners to translate research into production outcomes. Mentor and guide Research Engineers to apply research findings and developments to industrial domains. jobs.title: Product Growth Analytics Lead - Token Factory
jobs.description: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The role Nebius Token Factory is looking for a Product Growth Analytics Lead. You can work from our offices in Amsterdam or London , or remotely from any EU country . Your responsibilities will include: Build a comprehensive view of self-service customers, including usage patterns, customer health, satisfaction, retention risks, unmet needs, and growth opportunities. Translate customer demand and commercial plans into capacity forecasts and support capacity allocation decisions. Measure effective capacity utilization and identify opportunities to improve the commercial value of available capacity. Develop and evaluate pricing and packaging models, including guaranteed capacity, on-demand pricing, commitments, clawback mechanisms, and provisioned throughput units. Provide data-driven recommendations for the self-service and managed offerings, including customer segmentation, pricing, capacity, and product priorities. Partner with Product, Engineering, Applied AI, Finance, and Sales to turn insights into concrete product and operational improvements. We expect you to have: Strong commercial and product judgment, with the ability to balance customer value, monetization, growth, and profitability. Hands-on experience analysing large-scale customer, product, and usage datasets using analytical or distributed data-processing tools. Strong financial modelling skills and the ability to turn complex data into clear recommendations. Experience with pricing, packaging, monetization, or commercial analytics for technical or consumption-based products. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Sales, and Operations. A hands-on and proactive working style, with the ability to operate effectively in an ambiguous and technically complex environment. Benefits & Perks: Competitive compensation Career growth and learning opportunities Flexibility and ownership Collaborative and innovative culture Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects International environment and talented teams What's it like to work at Nebius: Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI Equal Opportunity Statement: Nebius is an equal opportunity employer.
